review_type: Author review of cumulative assessment/project/reference package; not independent validation

components.diagnostic: Eight fully answered prerequisite questions, 32 points, units/domains/logic and remediation routes.
components.examinations: Two distinct five-domain 100-point forms, with complete solutions and subpart scoring; analytic proofs, local calculus, exact systems, dynamics, constraints and numerical guarantees.
components.project: Original JSON inputs and stdlib benchmark, complete analytical capacity regimes, dual and strong-concavity distance certificate, capacity and payoff sensitivity, feasible numerical multiplier bracket and rounding limits.
components.oral_retention: Changed-resource oral protocol, five-domain delayed questions with solutions, scoring and chapter remediation map.
components.reference: Notation table, all twelve chapter routes and successor synthesis.

validation.arithmetic: Exact fractions for diagnostic, both forms and delayed numerical questions; normal equations and recurrence reconstruction; independent RK4 ODE checks.
validation.project: All supplied capacities checked against exact analytic KKT/dual solutions; sensitivity, envelope integral, coarse/fine stopping; off-baseline dense feasible-lattice comparisons.
validation.reasoning: Reviewed proof hypotheses, constrained signs and global uniqueness, implicit collision, strong-concavity first-order feasible-direction bound, residual-to-error hypotheses, stated scoring and transfer expectations.
validation.structure: Assessment components, twelve chapter links, download links, source routes, reference anchors and print aggregation checked.

corrections: Removed a deliberately incorrect intermediate retention value from the draft solution; the final optimum value is stated plainly and independently checked as 11.
Namespaced chapter and assessment fragment IDs in the combined print edition after detection of duplicate notation/concept/synthesis anchors. Individual reading pages keep their original anchor URLs.
Strengthened accepted-volume gates to require assessment state, recorded review and real project inputs/benchmark.
limitations: No independent human reviewer or learner validation of difficulty, timing or scoring thresholds.
General Jordan and nonlinear vector stability theorem proofs are explicitly bounded extensions in Chapter 11.
Floating computations are not outward-rounded certificates; exact baseline checks are separate.
Visual/mobile/print UI QA remains outstanding after earlier browser-policy rejection.
acceptance: Accepted by author after completed analytic and numerical review and successful structural checks; this is manuscript/package acceptance, not completion of learner competence or the whole library.
